title: Overdue handoff recovery, slice 1: a registered test-run gate with a durable next action proceeds automatically even if its coordinator misses a wake
outcome: When a registered test-run gate finishes with a recorded next action, the host durably records the handoff and its owner and, within a bounded time, dispatches the successor (wakes the session that owns the next step, or a designated recovery owner) without any user query. The overdue handoff is observable, a handoff is accepted and completed exactly once, and no evidence is dropped. Carriers and the land/push/install effect path are slice 2 (w-75b31ac5a7c9).
acceptance: A registered test-run gate with a durable next action (a Terminal or Credited test-run prerequisite) is automatically handed to a successor within a bounded time, even if its coordinator is idle or missed a wake. Carrier-completion prerequisites are outside this slice (w-75b31ac5a7c9).
A test simulating a missed wake or coordinator inactivity proves the successor proceeds without a user query.

A handoff is accepted by exactly one owner and completed at most once: acceptance and completion are compare-and-swap guarded, a conflicting completion is refused, an identical retry returns the original completion and changes nothing, and a completed handoff's record, evidence and history survive a restart (tests). The land/push/install effect path is outside this slice (w-75b31ac5a7c9).
The recovery owner and any overdue handoff are durable and observable (visible in host state or the UI and surviving a restart).
